report:
Blinded shadow review (iteration 7) of PR #1973 @ a87924eba43bcadc68dadec45a8bb6d2cb46ebf4. Full roster dispatched (code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter, comment-analyzer, pr-test-analyzer, final-pass requesting-code-review); type-design-analyzer correctly gated OFF (no new types). VERDICT: REJECT on two non-blocking Important findings, neither a false-RED/false-GREEN-on-main hazard.

CORRECTNESS & CI SAFETY: The lint passes on the real tree (rc=0, 1120/1120 files) and fails closed correctly on unreadable files (rc=1), malformed JSON (rc=2) and a missing 'frozen' object (rc=2). AC1 (stale/reverse guard), AC3 (new-occurrence forward guard), AC4/AC5/AC6 (fail-closed arms) all hold. The critical concern — a false RED on the required `lib + python tests` check on main after merge — was independently hunted by three reviewers and found to exist ONLY as the acknowledged, explicitly-parked concurrent-merge presence-baselining residual: because GitHub CI reconciles the post-merge tree, a PR that is green has already been reconciled against merged content, so the only main-RED path is a concurrent main advance between CI and merge. The transient (.changeset/) short-circuit precedes provenance in classify() and is never baselined, so version-consolidate deleting the changeset on merge cannot fire a stale-row RED (explicitly tested). No false-RED-on-main vector outside the parked residual was constructible.

FINDINGS (both Important, both non-blocking): (1) Row-level malformed bucket-record entries (missing 'file'/'path' key or wrong-type row in the hand-authored frozen.provenance / pending_sweep_baseline) raise an uncaught KeyError/TypeError instead of the clean exit-2 breadcrumb the module and its own test comment promise, violating CLAUDE.md's adversarial-parser convention — but it still exits non-zero (RED, safe direction), so it is a diagnostic-quality gap, not a CI-correctness hazard; cheap fix is a row-shape check in main(). (2) A test-coverage gap for the dual-role provenance-file drain steady-state (a provenance file losing only its prose remainder should fire a stale-baseline RED while the provenance guard stays green); the underlying code is already correct — this is a one-assertion test addition.

The change delivers only the enforcement mechanism; the mass prose sweep (AC2) is explicitly deferred to a follow-up that drains the grandfathered baseline. Both findings are quality improvements the fix loop can address cheaply; the mechanism is functionally sound and safe to merge on correctness grounds.
